summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by SuperX AI Technology Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reporting the resignation of independent director Mr. Ho Chuen Shin and the appointment of Mr. Shen Pao Hua Paul as independent director and Compensation Committee Chair. No disagreement triggered the resignation. Board committees were reconstituted accordingly. This is a routine director change, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing merely updates the board composition, which is ordinary corporate governance, not a forced or abrupt departure warranting a Management Changes classification.
